t: You are looking at The Boltons, a lens-shaped garden square in Brompton, in Kensington and Chelsea. Large, expansive houses face each other across the street, with communal gardens between them. The elliptical central gardens are Grade II listed on the Register of Historic Parks and Gardens. This is considered the second most expensive street in the country, with an average house price of twenty-three point one million pounds. The English author John Hughes, born in 1790, died here in 1857.
